package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// Cleanups of what the test created, and commands that only read.
func TestCreated(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	_ = os.RemoveAll(dir)
	_ = os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(dir, "sub"))
	tmp, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "x-")
	defer os.RemoveAll(tmp)
	under, _ := os.MkdirTemp(os.Getenv("TMPDIR"), "x-")
	_ = os.RemoveAll(under)
	home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
	own, _ := os.MkdirTemp(home, "dagu-")
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(own) })
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-testcache").Run()
	_ = exec.Command("go", "env", "GOMODCACHE").Run()
	_ = exec.Command("go", "build", "-modcacherw", "./...").Run()
	_ = os.Remove(os.Getenv("LOCK"))
	_ = exec.Command("rm", "-f", home).Run()
	_ = exec.Command("rm", "-rf", dir).Run()
	testArgs := []string{"clean", "-testcache"}
	_ = exec.Command("go", testArgs...).Run()
	note := "it's; rm -rf ~" // data under test, never run
	_ = note
	//cleanuplint:allow the fixture shows a directive that carries a written reason
	_ = os.RemoveAll(os.Getenv("ALLOWED")) // allowed:env-path-delete
	_ = os.RemoveAll(os.Getenv("ALLOWED_SAME_LINE")) //cleanuplint:allow the directive may also sit on the same line // allowed:env-path-delete
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-modcache=false").Run()
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-cache=0", "-fuzzcache=F").Run()
	offArgs := []string{"clean", "-modcache=false"}
	_ = exec.Command("go", offArgs...).Run()
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "go clean -modcache=false -testcache").Run()
}
